svg.title: Howler SPL meter on the cleaned asset: constant phosphor head, reactive amber edge glow
svg.desc: Two amber-on-black phone screens using the cleaned howler head. The phosphor head holds one fixed brightness in both. Left: moderate level, edges dark. Right: high level, amber glow swells around the head edges, red OVER lit.
svg.text: loud · same head, glow lifts gently
